# Fixtures for `pyc` (Python bytecode)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The programs print a fictitious harbour's tide table (Saltmere Harbour). Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/bytecode.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `tides.cpython-38.pyc` | CPython 3.8 py_compile, timestamp invalidation | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides.cpython-312.pyc` | CPython 3.12 py_compile, unchecked hash (PEP 552) | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides.cpython-313.pyc` | CPython 3.13 (Debian) py_compile, timestamp invalidation | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides.cpython-314.pyc` | CPython 3.14 py_compile, checked hash (PEP 552) | CC0-1.0 |
